Troubleshooting · 36/50 · conform

Wrong cut conformed

Failure signal

A wrong cut conformed condition is reported or detected during conform.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for conform does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Match edit hash, duration, event count and reference burn-in to the approved lock.

Corrective action

Stop downstream work, restore the approved turnover and document superseded versions.

Prevention

Add this verification to the conform gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
